data.source: 49 previously exposed diagnostic frames + 30 development frames from the independent landmark package
data.note: 49 exposed diagnostic + 30 development frames; no sealed test

proposed_continue_conditions.coordinate_mapping: synthetic anchor scale .5/.8/1.0 must pass before any detections are evaluated
proposed_continue_conditions.normal_plus_two_views: bbox IoU>=0.3 and anchor error<=5 deg in at least 3 of 9 bbox-labelled positives, spanning at least two families (north/reverse/static)
proposed_continue_conditions.localization: bbox-localization TP>=5/9 and anchor error<=5 deg for at least 4/8 reference-evaluable positives
proposed_continue_conditions.green_negatives: known similar green negatives (e.g. north s103 and reverse s83/s103) must not be accepted by color alone; FP<=3/22 is not sufficient if all FPs are green-like
proposed_continue_conditions.comparison: better than the old baseline failed state on reverse/north evidence; baseline had 0/12 reverse detections at the PROPOSED threshold; this detector should produce at least one correct reverse target if it claims reverse capability

evaluation.anchor_tp: anchor bearing error<=5 deg vs label green point
evaluation.joint_tp: presence and bbox IoU>=0.3 and anchor error<=5 deg, when reference available
evaluation.unavailable_reference: counted in presence; excluded only from anchor error denominator and reported separately
evaluation.unknown_rejected: retained in denominators; no deletion of positive failures
evaluation.old_baseline_anchor: old baseline has no anchor; its bbox-center bearing is historical diagnostic only, not compared as anchor bearing

decision_rule.pass: all proposed continue conditions met -> freeze method and collect 3-4 new independent GUI episodes for one sealed test
decision_rule.fail: any condition missing -> stop this heuristic; no new GUI collection; write negative evidence and next-method proposal

revision_reason: initial dev evaluation showed one false green structure (reverse s103) with green component area 9; target visible static green starts at 10 px in this asset. Bounded dev-only candidate-size filter; no sealed test exists or was used.
